description: Single-effect LiBr-H2O Type-I absorption HP. Extends F1a with: (1) part-load COP degradation due to incomplete desorption at reduced generator heat input; (2) COP penalty when T_gen deviates from design point; (3) cycling losses below PLR_min.

unit.name: Generic 100 kW_th single-effect LiBr-H2O absorption heat pump
unit.source: Hellmann & Ziegler (1999), Int. J. Refrigeration 22, 552-560; Herold, Radermacher & Klein (2016), Absorption Chillers and Heat Pumps, 2nd ed., CRC Press; Jakob et al. (2008), IEA Annex 34 absorption heat pump models.

C_d.note: Part-load degradation coeff for driving-heat utilization; lower than ASHP (0.25) because absorption cycling losses are smaller — Herold 2016 sec.6.4

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable load ratio before on/off cycling; absorption machines do not modulate below ~20% (Jakobs 2008 AHP data)

cycling_loss_factor.note: Extra COP penalty fraction per cycling event; thermal mass of generator/absorber dominates start-up loss

beta_T_gen.note: Generator temperature sensitivity: COP drops ~1.2% per K below T_gen_design due to incomplete desorption — fitted from Hellmann & Ziegler (1999) Fig.5
